jobs.occupation: Solution Architect, EndoIntelligence Hardware, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Do you want to help bring innovative medical solutions to life and improve patient care worldwide?

**Do you have a strong technical background within hardware development and experience designing solutions for complex products involving multiple technologies? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you. Apply today and join us for a career #ForeverForward!

**Designing solutions for next-generation endoscopy systems

**At Ambu, we develop innovative endoscopy solutions used by healthcare professionals around the world. As part of the EndoIntelligence Solutions area in the Global R&D organization, you will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product management, operations, quality, and regulatory affairs to develop solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives.

As Hardware Solution Architect you will play a key role in defining and maturing hardware solutions for our endoscopy platforms. Working closely with systems engineers, project teams, engineering specialists, suppliers, and technology partners, you will help ensure solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with overall system requirements.

Our teams work in a collaborative environment where open dialogue, technical curiosity, and cross-functional teamwork are key to solving complex challenges.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Participate in early-phase product development activities, including concept development, technology evaluations, and feasibility assessments.

• Guide the development and maturation of hardware solutions in collaboration with cross-functional development teams.

• Define and maintain solution architectures for new products and platform developments.

• Collaborate across mechanical, electronics, optics, manufacturing, and software disciplines to develop integrated system solutions.

• Support architectural trade-off discussions balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, risk, and cost.

• Ensure solutions are aligned with system requirements, architectural principles, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with suppliers and technology partners on technical evaluations, component selection, and solution development.

• Contribute technical input to project planning and development activities.

• Maintain solution documentation and support architectural reviews.

• Support development and verification activities by helping resolve technical challenges and identifying potential risks.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognize that no candidate will match every qualification perfectly. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related technical field.

• Have experience developing complex products involving multiple technologies and engineering disciplines.

• Have experience with technical solution design, system architecture, or product development.

• Have experience with medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Enjoy working across disciplines to solve technical challenges and drive alignment.

• Have experience collaborating with external suppliers, development partners, or technology providers.

• Possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

English language proficiency, both written and spoken, is crucial for the role.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success, and by joining us you will become part of an international organization focused on developing innovative solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

We offer great opportunities for professional and personal development, a broad range of employee benefits, exciting technical challenges, and continuous learning throughout your career.

jobs.occupation: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

jobs.occupation: Technical Engineer – Power Electronics & Energy Control
jobs.description:
**Location: Denmark / Croatia

**Do you want to work on projects that drive energy efficiency and support the global transition to sustainable solutions? Are you passionate about power electronics, converter systems, and advanced energy control? Then this opportunity at DEIF A/S might be the right fit for you.

DEIF is a global leader in power efficiency, delivering advanced control solutions that support the green transition. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we are on an ambitious growth journey, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and intelligent energy management.

**About The Role

**As an Technical Engineer, you will join our Integration Team. We develop customized solutions for power generation and energy management systems across Marine, Offshore, and land-based industries.

In this role, you will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to design and implement solutions, particularly within:

• Power electronics and converter-based systems

• Power Management Systems (PMS)

• Marine and Offshore applications

You will play an important role in delivering reliable, efficient, and tailor-made solutions that create value for our customers and organization.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Develop and implement application software for energy control systems

• Contribute to Power Management System (PMS) solutions

• Specify, document, and test software to ensure high quality

• Collaborate with R&D, Sales, and Service teams across the organization

• Participate in commissioning and provide support during project execution

• Travel occasionally to execute and support projects and customers

**Your Background

**You are a technically strong and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working hands-on while collaborating with others.

**We Expect That You Have

**

• A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Electronics, or similar

• Experience or strong interest in power electronics and converters

• Experience with Power Management Systems (PMS)

• Experience from the Marine or Offshore industry is a strong advantage

• PLC programming skills (IEC 61131-3)

• Experience with CODESYS is preferred. Knowledge of programming in C and C++ is an additional advantage.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken

**What We Offer

**At DEIF, you will be part of a professional and collaborative environment where innovation and responsibility go hand in hand. We value initiative, knowledge sharing, and continuous development, and we support flexible ways of working.

You will have the opportunity to work with advanced technologies and contribute to solutions that make a real impact on the global energy transition.

**Interested?

**Send your application and CV as soon as possible via our website www.deif.com/careers . Be review applications on a continuous basis.

If you would like to learn more about the position, you are welcome to contact Damir Bajraktarevic on dba@deif.com or +45 2777 6762.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant - AI/ML
jobs.description:
**SENIOR CONSULTANT - AI/ML

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced AI/ML professional with a passion for applying emerging technologies to solve complex business challenges within Life Sciences? Do you enjoy working closely with clients, building relationships, and turning innovative ideas into practical solutions?

Devote Consulting is expanding its team and is looking for Senior Consultants with expertise in AI/ML and generative AI (genAI) implementation in regulated life sciences environments.

****Are We Looking for You?

• You thrive in the dynamic world of consulting and enjoy leading innovation in emerging technologies

• You combine strong technical AI/ML expertise with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• You take ownership of your work, driving high-quality outcomes that create business value while ensuring compliance

• You have experience delivering AI-driven solutions and improving processes within Life Sciences

• You enjoy translating complex technologies into practical solutions and helping clients navigate change

• You’ll excel in our high-achieving culture, with ample opportunities for both personal and professional growth

****What You’ll Do

****As a Senior Consultant at Devote Consulting, your key responsibilities will include:

• AI/ML implementation: Lead and support the implementation of generative AI use cases in life sciences and drive AI-driven transformation in R&D, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs

• Business process optimization: (Re)design and enhance workflows by integrating AI-driven solutions, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability in regulated environments

• Client collaboration and stakeholder management: Work closely with clients to understand their needs, provide expert advice, and translate business requirements into practical AI solutions

• Driving project success: Ensure progress across AI initiatives, maintaining high-quality standards, managing risk-based validation, and ensuring readiness for ongoing advancements in generative AI technologies

• Validation and compliance: Support risk-based validation of AI/ML solutions and ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and compliance documentation

• Project delivery: Take ownership of project activities and deliverables, managing stakeholders and ensuring successful implementation of AI initiatives

**Your Qualifications

**We’re looking for individuals with the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Data Science, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in AI/ML development, implementation, or platform engineering, including hands-on experience with generative AI or large language models (LLMs)

• Professional experience within Life Sciences (Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech), with an understanding of regulatory requirements

• Experience with software validation, GxP compliance, or related documentation in regulated environments

• Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with experience in client-facing roles and the ability to translate complex technical solutions into business value

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English and a genuine interest in working closely with clients

• Experience with Clinical R&D systems (e.g., CTMS, eTMF, EDC, QMS, or LIMS) is an advantage

****What We Offer

****At Devote Consulting, you'll have the opportunity to take responsibility, lead initiatives, and help shape the future of AI within Life Sciences.

You'll work directly with clients on projects where you can combine your technical expertise with consulting, business process improvement, and stakeholder management. Depending on the project, you may take on responsibilities as a specialist, business analyst, or project manager.

You'll become part of a collaborative, high-achieving consulting environment where professional development, knowledge sharing, and personal growth are highly valued.

****Ready to Join Us?

****We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to a recruitment process that ensures equal opportunities for all applicants. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!

jobs.occupation: ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B) / ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)
jobs.description:
ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS oplever fortsat vækst, og vi udvider nu vores team. Vi søger to engagerede, ansvarsfulde og stabile profiler til vores transport- og logistikdrift: En struktureret koordinator (med aktiv kørsel) og en professionel chauffør. Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag i en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet og højt serviceniveau er i højsædet. Læs mere om de to stillinger nedenfor og angiv i din ansøgning, hvilken rolle du søger.

PROFIL 1: Teamkoordinator & Chauffør (Hybridstilling)

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Dine primære opgaver:

• 
Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

• 
Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

• 
Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

• 
Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

• 
Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

• 
Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

• 
Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

• 
Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

• 
Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

• 
Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

• 
Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

• 
Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

• 
Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

• 
En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

• 
Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne, så snart de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte os via ovenstående e-mail, hvorefter vi vil vende tilbage til dig.

Language skills: You must be able to communicate fluently in Turkish and English (both written and spoken) for our internal coordination and business partners.

Valid driver's license (B) and experience as an active, experienced driver.

PROFILE 2: Driver (Driver's License B)

• 
Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

• 
Quality-conscious work: Making sure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy, and that applicable regulations for transport are followed.

• 
Collaboration: Close dialogue with the coordinator and the rest of the team to optimize the daily workflow.

Our expectations for you:

• 
Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

• 
Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

• 
Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

• 
A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

• 
A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

• 
Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

• 
Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

jobs.occupation: 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher in Abstractions for Quantum Software
jobs.description:
The Quantum Hub at University of Southern Denmark is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a two-year post to conduct research on abstractions for quantum software. As quantum computing advances towards large-scale fault-tolerant devices, robust hardware-independent software abstractions are becoming increasingly important for bridging the gap between quantum algorithms and physical implementations, and for making quantum computing accessible to software developers. We welcome applicants strongly motivated to contribute to this growing field with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

* Quantum algorithms

* Quantum circuit synthesis and optimisation

* Gaussian boson sampling

* Topological quantum computing

* Quantum error correction

* Fault-tolerant quantum computing

* Quantum programming languages and programming abstractions, including LLM-assisted quantum programming

* Quantum intermediate representations

* Quantum compilation, including AI/ML-assisted compilation techniques

* Quantum software engineering

* Quantum software design and testing

* Developer tools and usability in quantum software

The targeted starting date of the position is 1 January, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Note: We are not permitted to directly contact your academic references, so please ensure their letters have reached us by the deadline.  The application requirements are detailed at the end of this advertisement.  

Requirements
The candidate must have a PhD degree in mathematics, physics or computer science. 

Situation of the position
The position at the SDU Quantum Hub, will be situated at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark. SDU Quantum Hub is established with the ambition to create a highly international and interdisciplinary group within a broad spectrum of quantum research. Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs. 

Assessment
Shortlisting may be used. Shortlisted applicants will be assessed by an assessment committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. As part of the overall assessment, the applicant may be called for interview.

Conditions of employment
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. 

Information of salary rates can be found at: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu/international-staff

For non-Danish candidates there is an optional researcher taxation scheme (see the link above).

Read more: https://fa-eosd-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/da/sites/CX_1001/jobs/preview/4365/?keyword=4365&lastSelectedFacet=CATEGORIES&mode=location&selectedCategoriesFacet=300000002425904

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Dygtig og struktureret opvasker søges til Stubbs Gastronomi

jobs.occupation: Financial Controller, Associate/Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About the job

Do you thrive in a dynamic group function within an international organisation, working alongside like-minded and passionate colleagues? Do you have a solid foundation in audit or financial controlling and are you ready to take the next step in your career?

Then come join Saxo and play a key role in our financial and regulatory reporting while expanding your expertise in group reporting, IFRS reporting and regulatory reporting.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to join our skilled, dedicated and energetic reporting team of five employees, which is overall responsible for our IFRS Annual Report, including the group controlling and consolidation of more than 10 companies and regulatory reporting. You will be reporting directly to the Head Financial Controlling.

A few words from our Hiring Manager, Head of Financial Controlling, on the exciting position:

“If you enjoy working in a dynamic area, are ambitious in terms of taking on new challenges and developing your financial reporting skills alongside a strong team, this is the position for you. You will work together with a fantastic team. “

Our financial controlling team is responsible for monthly group consolidation and reporting processes, IFRS Group Annual Report and regulatory reporting to the Danish authorities. Further, we are responsible for coordination with the external auditors.

We are working together with Head of Financial Compliance who is our IFRS expert and moreover we work closely with the Commercial Finance team.

Responsibilities

In this role you will be a key player in Saxo’s external reporting procedures spanning from external reporting, optimisation of processes and working with our consolidation system.

To succeed in this role you should be curious, eager to learn and motivated to develop your controlling and reporting skills while contributing to the solving of complex accounting issues with support from experienced colleagues. You will be able to engage in close collaboration with the rest of your team as well as with our many stakeholders throughout a truly international organisation.

Your profile

• 
2-4 years of experience from an auditing firm or working within financial controlling

• 
Experience with complex accounting, reporting or audit engagements, providing exposure to a broad range of financial reporting topics and business environments

• 
Relevant degree in Finance or Accounting (e.g. Bachelor's degree or HD, including candidates currently pursuing an HD degree)

• 
Proficient in English both verbal and written and comfortable navigating an international organisation

• 
Experience in the financial sector is not a prerequisite

Furthermore, we are looking for a candidate who is structured, analytical and self-motivated. Someone with focus on effective problem solving while working with tight deadlines. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating with others and contributing with new perspectives.

Additionally, you have a proactive mindset and are comfortable taking on unfamiliar tasks.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.description:

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our High-Performance Development team in Denmark in a role focused on Improving and maintaining our power plant control software solution that is deployed to SGRE wind farms all over the world.

Your day may start with investigating a support case, perform remote troubleshooting and conduct detailed event analysis of power plant operations to identify and resolve software or configuration issues.

Afterwards you would resume to your regular software development task in the agile development team, with daily scrums and develop high-quality code including unit- and automated integration tests to ensure correct behavior.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop/maintain. C# .NET based platform that supports real-time control

• Design and develop data services that serve, process and store large data amounts within wind farms.

• Relentless focus on cyber solutions.

• Develop configuration validation, monitoring and tooling

• Clarify and mature requirements

• Contribute to planning

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, preferably combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• C# and automated testing.  Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C++ and Python language experience is appreciated as well.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development team in Denmark, where Software Developer/Engineers collaborate to constantly improve wind farm control and power plant solutions.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Work-life balance: Flexible working time

• Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

• Local benefits such as meal allowance, flexible plan and much more

• Self-driven development framework with insights and resources to develop and grow on technical and soft skills. Continuous learning

• International and cross Business Units

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: KPMG TechAcademy 2027
jobs.description:
Solve business challenges with AI alongside industry-leading experts

KPMG TechAcademy is an intensive, hands-on program for motivated students who want to explore how technology, AI and consulting come together to solve real business challenges.

Are you curious about:

• How AI can solve real business challenges?

• How consultants turn complex problems into actionable solutions?

• How to build and test AI-powered prototypes?

• How technology creates measurable business value?

• How the next generation of consulting is being shaped by AI?

If so, TechAcademy is the place for you! Join us to explore:

• The latest technologies used to solve real-world business and client challenges.

• Deep insights into new technologies and their impact.

• What it’s like to work at KPMG NewTech and in Management Consulting.

• The future of work and the skills you’ll need to thrive.

• How to move from best practices to NewPractice: shifting from human scaling to tech scaling.

Why join TechAcademy?

Throughout TechAcademy, you will work in a team on one shared, client-relevant case. You will receive business context, stakeholder perspectives, data and constraints, but you will not be given the answer.

It will be up to your team to identify the most valuable opportunity, select a solution worth pursuing and demonstrate why it can create an impact.

Along the way, you will receive inspiration, practical tools and sparring from KPMG NewTech professionals with experience in technology, AI and consulting. The program is designed to give you a realistic view of how we work with complex client challenges at KPMG NewTech.

Who are we looking for?

• TechAcademy is open to all university students (bachelor’s or master’s level), regardless of your field of study.

• You don’t need a tech background, what matters most is your interest in learning and genuine curiosity about technology. Skills can be taught, but interest in learning is key.

• Permanent residency in Copenhagen is required.

Practical information:

Format: Four evening sessions from 16:00-21:00

Location: KPMG, Copenhagen

Participation: Attendance and active participation are expected across all four sessions

Included: Dinner, refreshments, materials and access to relevant tools during the sessions

Session dates

• Session 1: 4 March, 2027

• Session 2: 18 March, 2027

• Session 3: 8 April, 2027

• Session 4 and finale: 23 April, 2027

Application:

To apply, submit a motivational letter or video as well as CV and grade transcripts no later than 30 November, 2026.

In your motivational letter, you should answer the following questions, max 1 page:

• Why would you like to participate in KPMG TechAcademy?

• What do you hope to learn or gain from the program?

• What makes you a strong candidate for TechAcademy?

You may draw on experiences from your studies, work, volunteering, student organisations or personal projects.

We expect to provide feedback to all applicants during December 2026 or January 2027.

We look forward to receiving your application!

KPMG is a global network of professional services firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 142 countries and have over 275,000 people working in member firms around the world. We work closely with a broad range of clients, such as business corporations, governments and public sector agencies and not-for-profit organisations. We support them in mitigating risks and exploiting business opportunities.

KPMG in Denmark is one of the fastest-growing professional services companies in Denmark, achieving 1.6 billion DKK in revenue in FY25. Together, over 600 employees and partners help our customers ignite their potential. By combining our global vision with comprehensive local knowledge, we create long-term value with a responsible use of technology with a human touch.

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About the job

At Saxo, we believe access to global capital markets should be simple and accessible. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Saxo's continued growth, innovation and strategic ambitions.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will provide trusted legal advice across a broad range of business initiatives, regulatory developments, corporate matters, commercial activities, governance matters and strategic projects. Working closely with stakeholders across our offices in both Denmark and abroad, you will help ensure that legal considerations enable business success while maintaining the highest standards of governance, integrity and regulatory compliance.

This role combines strong legal expertise with stakeholder management and business partnership. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will act as a trusted advisor across Saxo, providing pragmatic legal guidance and partnering with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation to navigate legal complexity and support informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will:

• Provide strategic legal advice to key stakeholders across Saxo.

• Support commercial, corporate, governance and regulatory matters affecting the business.

• Advise on marketing activities, customer communications, commercial partnerships and strategic business initiatives.

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure legal risks are appropriately identified and managed.

• Support product development, business expansion initiatives and corporate projects.

• Contribute to effective legal governance frameworks and decision-making processes.

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit and other control functions.

• Manage relationships with external counsel and legal service providers.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continuous development of the Legal function and strengthen its role as a proactive business partner.

Your profile

You are an experienced legal professional with a strong legal foundation and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges in a highly regulated environment.

You bring solid legal expertise, sound commercial judgement and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organisation. You are comfortable balancing legal risk with business priorities and have a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to legal advisory.

To succeed in this role, you will preferably have:

• A master's degree in law or an equivalent legal qualification.

• Solidlegal experience preferably gained either within the financial services industry or at a leading law firm advising clients in regulated sectors.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory framework governing financial institutions and financial markets.

• Experience advising business stakeholders on legal matters in relation to strategic initiatives and commercial matters.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business advice.

• A proactive, commercially minded and collaborative approach.

Beyond your technical legal capabilities, you are a trusted business partner who builds strong relationships across the organisation and enables informed decision-making while maintaining a high standard of legal governance and integrity.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. jobs.occupation: Kellner gesucht
jobs.description:
Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Wir erwarten von Ihnen, dass Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Energie und Ihr Engagement einbringen – sowohl in Ihrer Arbeit als auch im Umgang mit Kollegen und Gästen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und als Team zusammenarbeiten, wobei Wohlbefinden und Erfolg gleichermaßen im Fokus stehen.

Wir arbeiten intensiv daran, einen der besten Arbeitsplätze der Branche in Dänemark zu schaffen – und als Teil unseres Serviceteams werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Unternehmens mit ambitionierten Zielen und hoher Professionalität. Wir bieten gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld und viel Raum, um mit den Aufgaben zu wachsen.

Gehalt und Konditionen

Gehalt nach Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bieten wir Altersvorsorge, Krankenversicherung und weitere Beschäftigungsbedingungen gemäß Tarifvertrag und gegebenenfalls weiterer Vereinbarung. Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin oder nach Vereinbarung.

Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an unseren Restaurantleiter Rasmus Weimar unter rasmus@hesselet.dk – am besten so bald wie möglich, da wir laufend Vorstellungsgespräche führen.

Sollten Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie ihn gerne direkt unter der Telefonnummer (45) 65 31 30 29 kontaktieren.

Klingt das nach etwas, von dem Sie gerne hören würden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

jobs.occupation: Analyst (part-time) - KPMG Corporate Finance team
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and talented Analyst to join our growing Corporate Finance team in Copenhagen.

We offer ongoing professional and personal development opportunities related to high-profile engagements and business development. We work in a professional and high-performance environment but make sure that everyone in our team receives guidance and coaching, is engaged, have fun and work on exciting projects.

About KPMG Corporate Finance

We are a leading global mid-market M&A and Corporate Finance advisor, offering our services to private and public companies, private equity funds, as well as financial and institutional investors. We work closely with our colleagues across KPMG’s global network with more than 2,500 Corporate Finance professionals across 80 countries.

Corporate Finance is a cornerstone of KPMG Denmark’s vision to become the clear choice within professional services. We advise shareholders, leadership teams and non-executives on acquisitions & divestments of companies and assets, as well as more complex company valuations and business case modeling.

About the position

As a part of our Analyst team in Corporate Finance, your primary tasks will be:

• 
Assist our Directors and Partners in marketing & business development.

• 
Analyze markets, sectors and companies.

• 
Develop sector presentations and materials for marketing and case studies.

• 
Adapt KPMG’s International Thought Leadership & Industry to our business development.

• 
Assisting on M&A pitches and preparing for client meetings.

• 
Ad hoc tasks.

Weekly workload will be about 10-20 hours with flexibility during exam periods

About you, our newest team member

We seek a highly qualified and energetic Analyst with the following qualifications:

• 
You are in your final year of your bachelor’s degree or have recently started your master’s degree in finance, economics or similar.

• 
Open-minded with a positive and 'can-do' mind-set.

• 
Great academic background within finance, strategic management or economics.

• 
Solid analytical experience from management consulting, banking, investment, wealth management, private equity or similar.

• 
Strong analytical skills including experience with Excel and PowerPoint.

• 
Solid written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Fluency in English and Danish is a prerequisite.

Apply now

We take candidates into the recruitment process continuously so please do not hesitate to apply. This job post will close when the right candidates are found.

We are interested in hearing from you, so please feel free to contact Jacob Jespersen, Sr. Associate at +45 2579 2913 (jjespersen@kpmg.com) or Louise Christoffersen, Associate at +45 4099 6426 (lochristoffersen@kpmg.com) in case of any questions.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail due to GDPR compliance guidelines.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG.

jobs.occupation: Vision Developer – American Football
jobs.description:
Job description

Do you want to build intelligent software that powers the future of sports coaching? Are you passionate about transforming raw data and AI model predictions into meaningful, real-world metrics for professional American football players? Then come and join our ambitious and collaborative product team!

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

This is a great opportunity to join our growing New Sports team within our Tracking Department. Our team is responsible for the development of the firmware for our American football products. We are developing cutting-edge solutions that leverage deep learning, classic computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing algorithms to deliver product features. Through our market leading radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by some of the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• 
Detecting and tracking objects, such as balls, players, and clubs, across several different sports

• 
Optical flow for determining ball flight characteristics

• 
Calibration between radar and camera data for drawing tracks in broadcast television

• 
Human pose tracking for analyzing athlete performance

Are you our new colleague?

Our ideal candidate is specialized the area of computer vision and machine learning. You will be joining a team of specialists within these fields and together we strive to remain the best in the world at what we do. Your responsibilities will include development of new and existing products and core processes based on your experience and skills.

In the new sports team we value teamwork and openness. Therefore, we expect you to enjoy working with other highly motivated colleagues and help provide a good working environment. We do not expect that you can be an expert on every aspect of being a developer, but rather strive to improve and learn together with the team.

Responsibilities:

• 
Develop advanced DL, ML, classic computer vision, algorithms.

• 
Write production ready code, with emphasis on deployment, monitoring and supportability

• 
Design and execute experiments to acquire and prepare datasets for algorithm development

• 
Develop and extend tooling for computer vision development. This can include data visualization, annotation and debugging

• 
Develop appropriate system architecture for edge-based and server solutions

• 
Collaborate with engineers within Vision & AI and the tracking department to produce high quality cutting edge systems

Job requirements

• 
Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, mathematical modelling, or equivalent

• 
3+ years of practical experience in implementing and deploying computer vision systems, with a proven track record of successful project execution and system optimization

• 
Strong software development and programming skills within Python and C++

• 
Experienced in computer vision techniques, including object detection, video tracking, and image analysis, as well as deep learning and convolutional neural networks in machine learning

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive on taking an idea from concept to a polished implementation.

Nice to haves:

• 
Experience with or knowledge of image acquisition, camera calibration

• 
Preferably experience with or knowledge of video formats and camera hardware, drivers and low-level software

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative and pro-active in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables. We expect you to be of a similar caliber.

We offer:

• 
Highly skilled colleagues

• 
World class office facilities

• 
International environment with more than 35 nationalities in our HQ

• 
Social activities

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

For additional information about the position, please contact Troels Bastholm, Engineering manager at troels@trackman.recruitee.com. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.
